newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea won/dollar market closed, reopens Monday.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea won/dollar market closed, reopens Monday.

text.p: Seoul's won/dollar market is closed on Friday for the Lunar New Year holidays. Trading will resume on Monday.
The won closed firmer against the U.S. dollar on Thursday after the central bank's intervened by selling dollars. It ended at 867.50 after opening the day at an intraday low of 870.00.

The won has been pressured by the nation's huge trade deficit and the dollar's strength against the Japanese yen on world markets. South Korea posted a record monthly trade deficit of $3.48 billion in January.
